select_hint: Select or add a record on the left.
conds_title: Record condition: left as listed in the collection, right as measured
record_grade_avg: Record grade: average of the sides
image_convert_failed: The image could not be converted

copy_winner.one: {name} is better than {others} on the measured side.
copy_winner.other: {name} is better than {others} on all {n} measured sides.

copies_hint: For each side the latest recording of each copy is compared: first the grade, then clicks in the pauses, then in the music.
hist_hint: Each recording as a step, next to it the change from the previous one in percent (raw values per minute; in brackets the value above the deck baseline). Two “uncleaned” recordings in a row show the measurement uncertainty.
hist_too_quiet_one: one of the recordings was more than 14 dB too quiet
too_quiet_title: Recording more than 14 dB below the reference tone: small clicks are missed
side_empty: The side must not be empty
coll_taken_over: taken over when the record was added
pressing_title: Average of the sides of all copies (latest recording per copy and side). From 4 sides on, the best and the worst one are dropped as outliers; half steps count towards the worse grade
pressing_chip_title: Average of the list without outliers
cond_uncalibrated: The grade limits are not calibrated yet, the grade is a suggestion.
cond_push_confirm:
Set the media condition in your Discogs collection from “{from}” to “{to}”?
Only the record, not the sleeve. This changes your entry on Discogs.
col_music_tip: Clicks and pops per minute while music plays, confirmed by the second opinion: the grade comes from this
col_quiet_tip: Clicks + pops per minute in quiet passages (in brackets above the deck baseline); lowers the grade by at most one step
col_ticks_tip: Crackle per minute in quiet passages; lowers the grade by at most one step
sort_default_title: back to the order by copy and date
audio_deleted_no_compare: Audio deleted – no comparison possible any more
clip_tight_title: Level close to the limit, the count is still valid
skip_play_title: Play the skip (3 s before to 4 s after)
learned_title_graded: estimated real (learning model), the grade is based on it
report_title: Open the report of this recording
cover_replace_title: Click: replace your own cover (JPEG, PNG or WebP, scaled down to 1200 px)
cover_upload_title: Click: upload a cover (JPEG, PNG or WebP, scaled down to 1200 px)
side_lengths: Side lengths: {list} – used for the warning “side has probably ended”.
delete_record_confirm: Delete the record with all its recordings?
cleaning_title: How the record was treated before this recording; for “after”, the cleaning method
copy_title: If you own the same record more than once: which one is on the platter? Same spelling = same copy (case does not matter)
note_placeholder: e.g. scratch near the edge at track 2, audible crackle
recording_steps: Steps: clean the stylus → check the level (no red) → start recording → lower the stylus → the whole side including the run-out groove → lift the stylus → Stop. Best record “uncleaned” twice: comparing the two shows how precise the measurement is.
mixed_turntables: Recordings from different turntables: clicks and crackle are only comparable within the same turntable (own deck baseline, own stylus).
master_delete_confirm: Remove the master of side {side}? The measurement results are kept.

master_saved_queued.one: Master for side {side} saved, {n} recording is being measured against it.
master_saved_queued.other: Master for side {side} saved, {n} recordings are being measured against it.

compare_title: Two: before/after. More: all against the first one selected
compare_sides_mismatch: Sides {sides} cannot be overlaid. Only recordings of the same side are compared.
multi_hint: The reference is the first selected recording {ref}. Each further one is laid against it with the before/after logic: remained = at the same spot on both, gone = only on the reference, new = only on this recording.
multi_progress: {done} of {total} comparisons done, the page updates itself.
multi_remained_title: at the same spot as on the reference
multi_common_head: At the same spot on all {n} recordings: {count}
multi_common_hint: What sits at the same spot on every selected recording. If they are different copies, it is in the pressing itself (stamper, cut) or tracing distortion of the same passage of music; if it is the same copy before and after a wash, it is a scratch or a permanent defect.
